fields.label: Salary Component
fields.description: Leave blank to use this account for every HR Suite deduction of this company (the statutory injection). Name a component to override it for that component only - for example send Loan Repayment to the employee loan receivable.

fields.label: Deduction Account
fields.description: Account credited when HR Suite posts this deduction onto a Salary Slip. A Salary Component with no Salary Component Account makes Payroll Entry's accrual Journal Entry fail, which rolls the whole payroll run back.
